- Proposed map additions must be located in an existing loading zone measuring between 30 and 60
feet in length.

- To apply for the creation of a new loading zone or to move an existing loading zone applicants
must fill out the Loading Zone application located on the Traffic Safety webpage. Applicants
should wait to apply for a new map addition until after their loading zone has been approved.
Map showing the proposed location to be considered.

Written justification for why the map addition is necessary and beneficial to the business or
businesses and the City.

Proof of notice issued to all businesses within a City block of the desired valet parking zone of the
intent to apply for its use. Notice must be given of intent to apply at least ten (10) days prior to
submitting an application.
Completed Map Addition application (part I and II).

A completed valet parking plan form with a mapped parking plan meeting all requirements outlined
in Sec. 7.596 of Chapter 113.

Once the application has been approved there are additional fees that will be assessed by Parking
Services for the use of the zone.
